summary: Onboarding follow-up: the recovery's re-read under the build's watchdog; the exit question saying what it cannot know while a profile write is unanswered; a way back to the details after a refused profile write; three rules added to CLAUDE.md. First check fix-first (what was out and what had landed were tracked per build, so a retry could leave the page saying no limit was set while an earlier write carrying one landed); fixed by tracking them for the profile; re-check lows-only. Left: the failure's sentence can go stale after a late landing; a superseded build still sends its picks.
